properties.description: Returns one exact workload.WorkloadInstance with validated state, relationships, alarms, optional DeploymentInput snapshots, and optional assigned-resource details. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose default runtime user can read the required workload, alarm, and linked-resource objects. Names are OData-escaped, Moid-scoped, and must resolve exactly once. Bounded collections fail closed unless Count is a complete nonnegative integer within the bound. Secret-like data is recursively redacted. Include Execution Details and Include Debug Logs are retained for interface compatibility but are intentionally rejected with 422 before target access because the platform rejects embedded workflows inside an atomic and safely inlining the diagnostics branch would exceed the action limit. Generic API activities are necessary because no supported purpose-built details atomic exists; replace them when one becomes available.

import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Details input preparation did not complete"
errorMessage = "Details input preparation failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganization = ""
escapedDeployment = ""
escapedInstance = ""
resolveAssignedDetails = False
includeDeploymentInputs = False
includeExecutionDetails = False
includeDebugLogs = False

def as_bool(value):
    normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"true", "1", "yes"}:
        return True
    if normalized in {"false", "0", "no"}:
        return False
    raise ValueError("A boolean input was not serialized as true or false.")

try:
    organization = sys.argv[8]
    deployment = sys.argv[9]
    instance = sys.argv[10]
    resolveAssignedDetails = as_bool(sys.argv[4])
    includeDeploymentInputs = as_bool(sys.argv[5])
    includeExecutionDetails = as_bool(sys.argv[6])
    includeDebugLogs = as_bool(sys.argv[7])
    if not organization or not deployment or not instance:
        raise ValueError("Workload Organization, Workload Deployment Name, and Workload Instance Name must each be non-empty.")
    escapedOrganization = sys.argv[11]
    escapedDeployment = sys.argv[12]
    escapedInstance = sys.argv[13]
    if includeExecutionDetails or includeDebugLogs:
        status = "unsupported"
        statusCode = "422"
        statusMessage = "Execution diagnostics are unavailable in this importable atomic"
        errorMessage = "Include Execution Details and Include Debug Logs must both remain false. The platform rejects embedded workflows inside an atomic, and safely inlining this optional branch would exceed the workflow action limit."
        resultJson = json.dumps({
            "error":errorMessage,
            "executionDiagnosticsSupported":False,
            "includeExecutionDetails":includeExecutionDetails,
            "includeDebugLogs":includeDebugLogs,
            "targetAccessed":False
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        status = "ok"
        statusCode = "200"
        statusMessage = "Details inputs validated and OData literals escaped"
        errorMessage = ""
        resultJson = json.dumps({
            "inputValidation":"passed",
            "resolveAssignedDetails":resolveAssignedDetails,
            "includeDeploymentInputs":includeDeploymentInputs,
            "includeExecutionDetails":False,
            "includeDebugLogs":False
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
except ValueError as exc:
    status = "invalid"
    statusCode = "400"
    statusMessage = "Details input validation failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Details input preparation helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Details input preparation failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import sys
from urllib.parse import urlparse
status = 'helper-failure'
statusCode = '500'
statusMessage = 'Workload-instance details inspection did not complete'
errorMessage = 'Workload-instance details inspection failed.'
resultJson = json.dumps({'error': errorMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
instanceMoid = ''
instanceJson = '{}'
deploymentInputMoidsJson = '[]'
deploymentInputCount = 0
assignedRefsJson = '[]'
assignedRefCount = 0
detailQueueJson = '[]'
detailCount = 0
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    expectedOrganization = sys.argv[3]
    expectedDeployment = sys.argv[4]
    resolveAssignedDetails = sys.argv[6] in {'true', '1', 'yes'}
    results = body.get('Results') if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError('The workload-instance response does not contain a Results array.')
    if len(results) == 0:
        status = 'invalid'
        statusCode = '404'
        statusMessage = 'No exact workload instance match was found'
        errorMessage = 'The fully scoped workload-instance lookup returned zero matches; exactly one is required.'
        resultJson = json.dumps({'error': errorMessage, 'matchCount': 0}, separators=(',', ':'))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        status = 'invalid'
        statusCode = '409'
        statusMessage = 'Workload instance lookup is ambiguous'
        errorMessage = 'The fully scoped workload-instance lookup returned more than one match; exactly one is required.'
        resultJson = json.dumps({'error': errorMessage, 'matchCount': len(results)}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        organization = item.get('Organization') if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        deployment = item.get('WorkloadDeployment') if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        instanceMoid = item.get('Moid') if isinstance(item, dict) else ''
        assigned = item.get('AssignedResources') if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        serviceItems = item.get('ServiceItemInstances') if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if assigned is None:
            assigned = []
        if serviceItems is None:
            serviceItems = []
        validIdentity = isinstance(item, dict) and item.get('Name') == expectedName and (item.get('ObjectType') == 'workload.WorkloadInstance') and isinstance(instanceMoid, str) and bool(instanceMoid) and isinstance(organization, dict) and (organization.get('Moid') == expectedOrganization) and isinstance(deployment, dict) and (deployment.get('Moid') == expectedDeployment) and isinstance(assigned, list) and isinstance(serviceItems, list)
        if not validIdentity:
            status = 'invalid'
            statusCode = '502'
            statusMessage = 'Workload instance identity validation failed'
            errorMessage = 'The sole instance result did not preserve exact Name, Organization.Moid, WorkloadDeployment.Moid, concrete ObjectType, non-empty Moid, and relationship-array shapes.'
            resultJson = json.dumps({'error': errorMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
        else:
            inputMoids = []
            for field in ('DeploymentInput', 'LastDeploymentInput'):
                relation = item.get(field)
                if relation is None:
                    continue
                if not isinstance(relation, dict) or not isinstance(relation.get('Moid'), str) or (not relation.get('Moid')):
                    raise ValueError('%s is present but is not an exact relationship with a non-empty Moid.' % field)
                if relation['Moid'] not in inputMoids:
                    inputMoids.append(relation['Moid'])
            refs = []
            for index, assignedResource in enumerate(assigned):
                if not isinstance(assignedResource, dict):
                    raise ValueError('AssignedResources[%d] is not an object.' % index)
                for field in ('Resource', 'Lease', 'BluePrint', 'ServiceItemInstance'):
                    relation = assignedResource.get(field)
                    if relation is None:
                        continue
                    if not isinstance(relation, dict) or not isinstance(relation.get('Moid'), str) or (not relation.get('Moid')) or (not isinstance(relation.get('ObjectType'), str)) or (not relation.get('ObjectType')):
                        raise ValueError('AssignedResources[%d].%s is not a complete MoRef.' % (index, field))
                    refs.append({'kind': field, 'assignedResourceIndex': index, 'Moid': relation['Moid'], 'ObjectType': relation['ObjectType'], 'link': relation.get('link')})
            for index, relation in enumerate(serviceItems):
                if not isinstance(relation, dict) or not isinstance(relation.get('Moid'), str) or (not relation.get('Moid')):
                    raise ValueError('ServiceItemInstances[%d] is not a complete relationship.' % index)
            detailQueue = []
            detailSeen = set()
            if resolveAssignedDetails:
                for ref in refs:
                    link = ref.get('link')
                    if not isinstance(link, str) or not link:
                        status = 'invalid'
                        statusCode = '422'
                        statusMessage = 'Assigned-resource detail link is unavailable'
                        errorMessage = 'A requested Resource, Lease, BluePrint, or ServiceItemInstance MoRef lacks the schema-defined link required for exact polymorphic dereference. Partial details are not returned.'
                        break
                    parsed = urlparse(link)
                    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment or parsed.params:
                        raise ValueError('A MoRef link contains query, fragment, or parameter data and is not accepted.')
                    path = parsed.path if parsed.scheme else link
                    if not path.startswith('/api/v1/') or not path.endswith('/' + ref['Moid']):
                        raise ValueError('A MoRef link is not an exact /api/v1 item URL ending in its Moid.')
                    key = (ref['Moid'], ref['ObjectType'], ref['kind'])
                    if key not in detailSeen:
                        detailSeen.add(key)
                        detailQueue.append({'Moid': ref['Moid'], 'ObjectType': ref['ObjectType'], 'kind': ref['kind'], 'url': path})
            if status == 'helper-failure' and len(detailQueue) > 100:
                status = 'invalid'
                statusCode = '413'
                statusMessage = 'Assigned-resource reference count exceeds the safe bound'
                errorMessage = 'More than 100 unique assigned-resource references require dereference; this workflow refuses a partial bundle.'
            deploymentInputMoidsJson = json.dumps(inputMoids, separators=(',', ':'))
            deploymentInputCount = len(inputMoids)
            assignedRefsJson = json.dumps(refs, separators=(',', ':'))
            assignedRefCount = len(refs)
            detailQueueJson = json.dumps(detailQueue, separators=(',', ':'))
            detailCount = len(detailQueue)
            instanceJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(',', ':'))
            if status == 'helper-failure':
                status = 'ok'
                statusCode = '200'
                statusMessage = 'Exact workload instance resolved and relationships indexed'
                errorMessage = ''
            resultJson = json.dumps({'Moid': instanceMoid, 'Name': expectedName, 'DeploymentInputCount': deploymentInputCount, 'AssignedReferenceCount': assignedRefCount, 'ServiceItemCount': len(serviceItems)}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    status = 'helper-failure'
    statusCode = '500'
    statusMessage = 'Workload-instance details inspection helper failed'
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({'error': 'Workload-instance details inspection failed', 'detail': errorMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))

import json
import re
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Workload-instance details assembly did not complete"
errorMessage = "Workload-instance details assembly failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

SENSITIVE = ("password", "passwd", "secret", "token", "credential", "authorization", "cookie", "privatekey", "private_key", "apikey", "api_key")
INLINE = re.compile(r"(?i)(bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+|((?:password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\s*[:=]\s*)[^,;\s]+")

def redact(value, key=""):
    keyNorm = str(key).replace("-", "").replace("_", "").lower()
    if any(word.replace("_", "") in keyNorm for word in SENSITIVE):
        return "***REDACTED***"
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k:redact(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [redact(v, key) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return INLINE.sub(lambda m: (m.group(1) or m.group(2) or "") + "***REDACTED***", value)
    return value

try:
    instance = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    alarms = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    deploymentInputs = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    assignedDetails = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    executionDetails = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
    flags = json.loads(sys.argv[6])
    if not isinstance(instance, dict) or instance.get("ObjectType") != "workload.WorkloadInstance" or not isinstance(instance.get("Moid"), str) or not instance.get("Moid"):
        raise ValueError("The selected primary workload instance is not a valid exact resource object.")
    if not all(isinstance(v, list) for v in (alarms, deploymentInputs, assignedDetails)) or not isinstance(executionDetails, dict):
        raise ValueError("One or more related diagnostics accumulators are not arrays.")
    result = {
        "workloadInstance":instance,
        "alarms":alarms,
        "deploymentInputs":deploymentInputs,
        "assignedResourceDetails":assignedDetails,
        "executionDetails":executionDetails,
        "options":flags,
        "limitations":[
            "Execution details and debug logs are unavailable in this importable atomic; requesting either option is rejected with 422 before target access.",
            "Assigned-resource polymorphic dereference uses each returned mo.MoRef link and fails rather than guessing a collection path.",
            "Secret-like keys and inline token patterns are redacted recursively from the final bundle."
        ]
    }
    redacted = redact(result)
    resultJson = json.dumps(redacted, separators=(",", ":"))
    status = "ok"
    statusCode = "200"
    statusMessage = "Exact workload instance details retrieved"
    errorMessage = ""
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Workload-instance details assembly helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Workload-instance details assembly failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
